notes.title: Beta Update V0.0.6
notes.content:
Welcome, recruit, this patch increases the maps size and adds a new enemy have fun playing!

[b]Version 0.0.6 Patchnotes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new enemy called SpiderBot, will explode when in close proximity
[*] Balanced the new armor recipes, should be slightly easier to get
[*] Increased the map size from 12 x 12 -> 35 x 35
[*] Added loot boxes in the game that contain extra loot
[*] Added damage scaling, so when you out level an enemy you will receive less damage 
[*] Some animation fixes with some enemies
[*] Fixed the Piercing skill, will now pierce enemies correctly.
[/list]

Have an awesome adventure recruit, and ensure the safety of the stars!

notes.title: Beta Update V0.0.5
notes.content:
Welcome, recruit, This patch was more of a technical patch, the focus went to get preliminary controller support working. You can now play the game using the controller, the only screens that need some love are the 3D Printer and the Equipment Bay. 

We introduced new hub feature called the Load out. You can manage your equipment and view your stats from that screen. The first armor is now also available to 3Dprint.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44691171/906b2705891d57013e42ab6f17fec3fa92aa4663.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44691171/17e496b371dfa7920d271e7087c2eff10b44076c.jpg[/img]

[b]Version 0.0.5 Patchnotes[/b]
[list]
[*] Refactored the way statistics work, it should be more easy to add modifiers to skills and equipment
[*] Added a new HP Regen modifier, so you can regain some health until there is some meaningful way to heal yourself
[*] Added a new Data Collection screen, to give us permission to track in game statistics (Required during the beta)
[*] Cleared rooms in an expedition now stay cleared. Will add cleared room indicators on the minimap in a later update.
[*] Added preliminary controller support, the highlighted color is developer red, I will make it nicer in a future update.
[*] Added a load out screen to the hub where you can inspect your stats and equip equipment
[*] Added a new recipe for the "Basic Elite Armor" this gives you some more survivability while playing. 
[/list]

Have an awesome adventure recruit, and ensure the safety of the stars!

notes.title: Beta Update V0.0.4
notes.content:
Welcome, recruit, This latest patch introduces a new mechanic, the 'Escape Pod.' This remarkable pod enables you to safely touch down on space stations, but bear in mind, it requires a brief recharge period. While you await its reactivation, take the opportunity to plunder and embark on thrilling explorations into the unknown. When your escape pod is fully recharged, make your way back to the designated landing site and ensure your secure journey back to the safety of home.

[b]Version 0.0.4 Patchnotes[/b]
[list]
[*] Balanced the blueprints once more, make it a bit less of a grind to gather materials
[*] Added sound effects for the droids
[*] Added the escape pod, a new mechanic to leave space stations.
[*] Fixed a few bugs with dungeon generation
[*] Fixed the battle music skipping if intensities changed to fast
[*] Added basic game performance analytics 
[/list]

Have an awesome adventure recruit, and ensure the safety of the stars!

notes.title: Beta Update V0.0.2
notes.content:
Welcome recruit, this build has some substantial UI improvements over the last version. Some new enemies and bug fixes

[b]Version 0.0.2 Patchnotes[/b]
[list]
[*] Overhauled the 3D printer UI and is now accessible from the hub
[*] Overhauled the inventory UI and is now accessible from the hub
[*] Add a few new recipes and items
[*] Add a Tier 2 Rare Rifle to the printer
[*] The upgrade station now allows to select which weapon to upgrade, it's not possible to equip weapons yet but it will auto equip the strongest weapon.
[*] Added a new Droid enemy, it still mimics Rapax behaviour, ranged attacks will be added later
[/list]
